rubrics.justification: The description is largely consistent with the image and reported 3BC grade: loosely defined ICM, sparse/poor TE, and fair overall quality. Minor uncertainty around calling it possibly partially collapsed/early expanded adds speculation beyond what is clearly visible.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male-factor diagnosis, prior cycle history, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo morphology to contextualize prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around young age offsetting weaker morphology. Minor overreach appears in discussing fresh-cycle hormonal environment and sperm DNA fragmentation without direct supporting data.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET in a young patient and not overinterpreting one failed transfer. Slight deviations include somewhat speculative adjunct considerations not strictly indicated in this first-cycle case.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, counseling, endometrial review, and future-cycle planning, with appropriate nuance about when to escalate evaluation.
